description: A man in a flat cap and dark shirt with a white apron stands in a dim industrial bakery, holding a dark round sandwich cookie in both hands and looking down at it. Behind him are trays of similar dark round cookies on a conveyor and rows of cookies on racks, with old iron machinery, gears, pipes, a brick wall and a window with steam. The style is a painterly oil-like rendering, filling the whole frame with no visible text, border or frame.
